request.note: No payload. The handler does not read `data`.

responses.name: Channel
responses.when: All checks pass: the server starts the channel `c.town` with `ms: 3000`. If a `town` channel runs already, it keeps the time that remains (never more than 3,000).

responses.name: Started
responses.when: All checks pass, after the `player` update. The teleport comes later.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `false`: the teleport did not happen yet.

responses.name: Arrived
responses.when: Later, when `c.town` reaches 0 in the game loop. The server lowers by 4,000 ms each condition that is not a debuff and has less than 60,000 ms left (`decay_s`) and sets `last.town`. Then it moves you to spawn 0 of your current instance with `effect: 1`. Then two `player` updates follow (one from the move, then a full one).

rows.when: You are in a map of the Cave of Many Dreams.
You cannot walk (`can_walk`: dead, `stunned`, `fingered`, `stoned`, `deepfreezed`, `sleeping`, or `dash`), or you are in `jail`.

also.when: The channel ends: clients that saw you before the teleport.
also.summary: `{id, reason: "transport", to, effect: 1}`. See the `leave` entry for the fields.

order: after 3,000 ms: `disappear` to clients near you, `new_map` to you, then two `player` updates
